chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no zakat on animals kept for eating, nor on the young animal that is raised for two years, nor on a milking sheep, nor on the breeding male of the sheep."

key_terms.الْأَكِيلَةِ: an animal kept for eating or personal consumption
key_terms.شَاةِ لَبَنٍ: a sheep kept for milk production
key_terms.صَدَقَةٌ: zakat, the obligatory alms due on qualifying property
key_terms.فَحْلِ الْغَنَمِ: the breeding male of the sheep

ai.seo_question: Which types of sheep or livestock are exempt from zakat in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states specific categories of livestock on which zakat is not due. It clarifies exemptions related to personal use, upbringing, milk production, and breeding function within the laws of zakat.
